BirdoVPN

Official self-hosted F-Droid repository for BirdoVPN — a fast, private, quantum-resistant VPN. Add this repository to your F-Droid client to install BirdoVPN and get automatic updates. Every APK here is the same developer-signed build published on GitHub Releases.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://birdovpn.github.io/Mobile-Client/fdroid/repo
